objective: Repair BUKLOD MAIN mentoring reports so verified mentors can find existing mentees and request name-based linking when none appear, with protected admin verification before attendance or rewards.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main mentoring report source blob 315a766d776ea88d7ea013fbbbf772cd34c4c65d inspected on 2026-11-23; zero-mentee screen contained no name-entry action. Live installed runtime, OTA fingerprint, and isolated test database were not verified.
chosenApproach: Add an assigned-mentee search and secure full-name link-request queue; a System Admin matches the requested name to a registered active account and creates the existing mentor assignment in an audited, atomic RPC. Reporting still counts only the existing canonical assigned roster.
selectionRationale: A name-only report would fabricate attendees and BP. A dead-end admin instruction is not a usable input. A bounded verification request gives a real field without weakening roster authorization.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Make mentoring attendee selection usable while preserving report auth, photo, consent, and idempotent receipts.
preservedBehaviors: Existing report submission, private photo evidence, selected linked attendee IDs, correction flow and duplicate request handling remain intact.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add private mentor-request and authorized System Admin linking RPCs without allowing arbitrary attendees or unaudited privilege grants.
preservedBehaviors: Protected admin cannot be a rewarded mentor, unauthorized members cannot create assignments, rate limits and row-level security deny direct request table access.

preserveBehaviors: Existing production Supabase data and deployed OTA stay untouched until isolated DB migration and RC tests pass.
No direct creation of assigned learners by mentors; only linked active member IDs may be submitted.
Report lesson, location, 20-character notes, private photo, consent, reviewer and BP rules unchanged.
No new native module, app version, build metadata, routing, ads or navigation changes.
acceptanceChecks: Assigned learner name search displays only existing authorized relationships, with tap selection and clear empty/search-miss guidance.
Request name persists once and shows pending state; missing backend RPC degrades safely without breaking existing reports.
Verified System Admin can approve/reject using a specific active account with review note; non-admin and unauthenticated attempts fail.
Replays, parallel requests, revoked mentor, protected identity, unknown member, rate limits and direct table access tested in isolated DB.
Focused Node and SQL tests pass; source type check plus ad/nav and compact spacing regression gates pass.
Manual Android weak-network, retry, photo upload and mentee reentry tests completed in isolated RC.
Release only through consolidated DEV to verified RC to production OTA with runtime and production evidence.
alternativeApproaches: Free-text attendee stored directly in reports: rejected because it bypasses real member identity, assignment constraints and BP integrity.
Show only an instruction to contact administrator: rejected because there is no usable mentee-entry action or tracked review.
Expose unrestricted member directory to mentors: rejected because it leaks profile data and permits unverified enrollment.
